translations.web: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues, or in the city.
translations.bsb: Yet my accusers did not find me debating with anyone in the temple or riling up a crowd in the synagogues or in the city.
translations.kjv: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
translations.asv: and neither in the temple did they find me disputing with any man or stirring up a crowd, nor in the synagogues, nor in the city.
